_about: What the owner is asked to playtest this sprint. Shown on the main menu and in the F1 menu (scripts/ui/help_menu.gd). Claude keeps it current: rewrite it whenever a sprint's playtest targets change.
sprint: Sprint 4: Silly and Serious - two games on one engine
intro: Thanks for testing! F3 anything odd (with a note - it takes a picture too), F4 if it feels slow - and say which mode you were in. F1 or D-pad down opens this again.

items.title: Pick a game: Silly or Serious
items.try: The main menu starts with two buttons. Each mode has its own save (Continue / New game follow the pick) and its own difficulty, so a Silly Easy game and a Serious Hard game don't overwrite each other. Your old save is now the Silly one. The pause menu says which mode you're in.
items.ask: Is it clear which game you're starting? Should the choice look bigger or more different?

items.title: Serious: the old robot in the crooked house
items.try: No Angry Zombie and no tiny curse. In his place: a rusted robot of your own make, slumped in the corner, one lens flickering. Look at it, then share some battery (25%, it won't take your last bit). It wakes, talks, and gives you what it kept in the wardrobe.
items.ask: Does it read as an old version of you? Is the battery cost fair? Should it give a memory you can look at later (next sprint)?

items.title: Silly: the wobbly robot
items.try: Drive and stop suddenly, turn hard, bump into walls, drop off something high (it cartwheels), get hit in the Sentry fight (it spins). Smash things: the bits fly further. Movement and collision are unchanged - it's all in the model.
items.ask: Goofy enough? Too much (seasick), too little? What else should wobble?

items.title: Silly: sounds
items.try: The game's first sounds, made in code: boing (jump), splat (landing), bonk (walls, smasher), honk (breaking), pop (pickups), wah-wah (getting hit, the zombie's curse). Serious is silent for now.
items.ask: Fun or annoying? Any that sound cheap? (If they do, a free sound pack is the next step - I'd ask before adding one.)

items.title: Two looks
items.try: Serious is darker, greyer and foggier, and your robot is worn metal. Silly is brighter and more colourful, and your robot is toy plastic (yellow, red, blue). Look at the forest and the city in both, day and night.
items.ask: Does each mode feel like its own game? F4 in each mode on the laptop and the Surface, please - the grade should cost almost nothing.

items.title: Story in two voices
items.try: Every story card now has a Silly text (short, jokey) and a Serious one (gritty; the wake-up says the city is north). The fight words too: KA-POW and BOING in Silly, CLEAN HIT and PARRIED in Serious.
items.ask: Which lines would you change? (These are drafts.) Your save_74 note - fewer story pop-ups - is still to talk through.

items.title: Fixed: the fight ring's button, the Sentry's loot
items.try: Defending with a tool, the ring now shows RT / left click (it said A). The 'Your turn' line clears on the Sentry's turn. Beaten, cut or beam the Sentry itself to salvage its plating; the plating sits on the ground with a bright seam.
items.ask: Any other place where the screen names the wrong button?

items.title: Tune it yourself: F10 tools, F9 detector
items.try: F10 opens sliders for the cutter, smasher and laser; F9 for the detector. Close the panel when it feels right: the values are logged and I bake them in.
items.ask: Which values felt best? (Just close the panel - I read them from the log.)
